description: AstroBase is an interactive, browser-based space outpost life-support simulation game designed for students and young space enthusiasts. Space-themed educational content often oversimplifies real mission engineering trade-offs or presents them at a level too complex for young learners. AstroBase makes these trade-offs tangible and fun: players take the seat of Flight Director managing Moon Base Artemis (Shackleton Rim) or Mars Base Ares (Jezero Crater).
